jobs.description: Leading enterprise product company in Noida Sector 62 seeks a talented Senior Full-Stack Engineer. You will spearhead high-throughput cloud microservices, optimize low-latency APIs, and mentor junior engineers on clean architectural standards.
requirements: 5+ years professional experience building enterprise applications with Node.js and React.
Deep hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis caching, and Docker.
Proven expertise in AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS) and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong problem-solving skills and familiarity with agile sprint workflows.

Proven history of consistently surpassing ₹15+ Cr annual revenue targets.

requirements: 12+ years experience in logistics, warehousing operations, or industrial supply chain management.
Direct experience handling large automated sortation facilities and fleet management.
Demonstrated expertise in P&L accountability (₹50+ Cr annual operational budget).
Location accessibility to Azadpur / GT Karnal Road / Kundli industrial belt.

jobs.title: Customer Success & Key Account Manager (Walk-in)
jobs.qualification: Any Graduate / Postgraduate with strong communication
jobs.description: Rapid-growth D2C consumer goods brand based in Okhla Phase III is holding walk-in interviews for passionate Customer Success and Account Management specialists. Direct client interaction, retention metrics, and escalation management.

Fluent verbal and written English communication.
Experience with Zendesk, Freshdesk, Salesforce CRM, or HubSpot.
Immediate joiners or 15 days notice period strictly preferred.

jobs.title: Lead Valuation & Financial Analyst (CFA)

jobs.description: Fast-growing FinTech investment firm at DLF Cyber City Gurgaon seeks a Lead Valuation Analyst to drive financial modeling, portfolio risk assessments, private equity due diligence, and statutory audit compliance.
requirements: CFA Charterholder or qualified Chartered Accountant with 5+ years experience in investment banking, equity research, or valuation advisory.
Advanced financial modeling skills in Excel, Bloomberg Terminal, and PowerBI.
Thorough understanding of SEBI guidelines, RBI compliance, and cross-border M&A valuations.
Outstanding presentation skills with CXO stakeholders.

jobs.description: Future Care Global is expanding its internal recruitment delivery team at our Azadpur North Delhi head office. You will head end-to-end recruitment pipelines for our premier corporate clients across Delhi, Noida, and Gurgaon.
requirements: 2 to 5 years hands-on experience in corporate or agency recruitment in Delhi/NCR.
Strong network of IT, Finance, or Engineering professionals.
Proven expertise in headhunting, LinkedIn Recruiter, and candidate closing.
Goal-driven attitude with excellent stakeholder management.

jobs.title: Plant Production Head (Manufacturing & Precision Tooling)
jobs.qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Industrial Engineering
jobs.description: ISO 9001 certified precision manufacturing unit in Narela Industrial Zone requires an experienced Plant Head to oversee production scheduling, CNC machining floors, quality control standards, and factory labor compliance.
requirements: 10+ years in discrete engineering manufacturing or automotive component fabrication.
Thorough expertise in Kaizen, 5S, Six Sigma, and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM).
Strong knowledge of Delhi State labor statutory requirements and OSHA standards.
Proven record of reducing scrap rate below 1.2% while increasing OEE by 15%.
